title: Example Lighthouse Service Historical Overview
relevant_excerpt: The Example Lighthouse Service operated 47 stations along the eastern coast between 1852 and 1939, transitioning from oil lamps to electric beacons by 1925.

title: Daily Life of a 19th-Century Lighthouse Keeper
author: J. Whitfield
relevant_excerpt: Keepers were required to log weather conditions every four hours and maintain a two-year supply of oil on isolated stations, a requirement that shaped station architecture.
